component.name: Nostr Vault
component.summary: Your own Nostr relay and media vault, on your computer

description.p: Nostr Vault keeps your notes, messages and media on a machine you own. This app runs the vault while you are logged in and shows it in a window: your feed, your vault, your devices and settings. Phones on your network reach it on the vault's port.
The vault never holds your Nostr secret key. Signing in is done the same way as in any browser.
